content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by IIT Indian School of Mines Dhanbad, also known as IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, located in Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under advertisement number SRDP 1285 G for temporary contractual engagement.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech, M.E., or M.Tech in Petroleum Engineering or Chemical Engineering, or an M.Sc. in Chemistry, alongside valid GATE or NET qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy layer), and female candidates according to GOI/DST guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37000 plus HRA for the first two years, which increases to Rs. 42000 plus HRA per month thereafter.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for submitting the form?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for candidates belonging to any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application through email is 05 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively via email. Interested applicants should send their bio-data and necessary certificates to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this JRF post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the shortlisted candidates involves an online interview, which is tentatively scheduled to be conducted on 07 October 2026.
